recipe.title: Carbonara | Basics with Babish
recipe.description: Classic Roman pasta tossed with guanciale, eggs, Pecorino Romano, and black pepper.

steps.description: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente, reserving some pasta water.
Cut the guanciale into small lardons or thin strips.
Render the guanciale in a cold pan over medium heat until the fat is released and the pieces are crispy.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, egg yolk, finely grated Pecorino Romano, and plenty of ground black pepper.
Add the drained hot spaghetti to the pan with the rendered guanciale and toss to coat in the fat.
Off the heat, pour in the egg and cheese mixture and toss vigorously, adding splashes of reserved pasta water until silky and creamy.
Serve immediately, finishing each plate with extra grated Pecorino Romano and freshly ground black pepper.

recipe.title: Binging with Babish: Master of None Carbonara
recipe.description: Classic Roman pasta carbonara inspired by Master of None's Dev.

steps.description: Slice the guanciale into thin strips or small cubes.
Whisk the egg yolks, whole egg, grated cheeses, and freshly cracked black pepper in a bowl.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Render the guanciale in a cold pan over medium heat until crispy and golden.
Transfer the hot drained pasta into the pan with guanciale, off the heat, and toss to coat.
Off the heat, pour in the egg-cheese mixture and toss vigorously, adding pasta water to loosen into a silky sauce.
Plate the carbonara and top with extra grated Pecorino and cracked black pepper.

recipe.title: One-Pot Creamy Mushroom And Chicken Pasta
recipe.description: Creamy farfalle with chicken, mushrooms, and spinach cooked in one pot.

steps.description: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large pot on medium heat. Brown chicken and cook through, then set aside.
Add 1 tbsp olive oil and diced onion to the pot, stir, and cook down for 1-2 minutes.
Add mushrooms and minced garlic, stir to combine with onion, then season with salt, pepper, thyme, and paprika.
Add chicken broth and heavy cream, stir, and bring to a boil. Then add the farfalle pasta.
Cook pasta according to package instructions, stirring every 1-2 minutes to prevent clumping (may take slightly longer than boiling in water).
Once pasta is al dente, stir in spinach and the cooked chicken until spinach wilts, then add parmesan and stir until smooth.
Top with extra parmesan and serve.

recipe.title: Creamy Chicken Penne
recipe.description: Creamy bacon and parmesan penne with chicken, spinach, and tomatoes.

steps.description: In a deep skillet, fry the bacon until crispy. Remove to a paper towel to drain, and chop.
In the same skillet, cook the chicken with salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and paprika.
Add garlic and cook until soft.
Add spinach and tomatoes, and cook until spinach is wilted.
Add the cream and parmesan, and bring to a boil.
Add the penne and bacon, and stir until fully coated in sauce. Serve with fresh parsley, parmesan, and red pepper flakes if desired.

recipe.title: Real Spaghetti Carbonara | Antonio Carluccio
recipe.description: Authentic Italian spaghetti carbonara with guanciale, egg yolks and pecorino.

steps.description: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Cut the guanciale into small strips or cubes.
In a bowl, whisk the egg yolks with the grated pecorino and freshly ground black pepper. For an extra creamy taste add one more yolk.
In a pan over medium heat, sauté the guanciale until golden and the fat has rendered, then reduce heat slightly.
Drain the pasta (reserving some cooking water) and toss it in the pan with the guanciale off the heat.
Off the heat, pour in the egg yolk and pecorino mixture and stir quickly to coat, adding a splash of pasta water for a silky sauce.
Serve immediately, topped with extra grated pecorino and freshly ground black pepper.

recipe.title: Cowboy Cornbread Chicken | Food Wishes
recipe.description: One-pot Southwest-style cornbread baked over seasoned chicken with chipotle hot honey butter.

steps.description: Season the chicken thighs all over with salt, pepper, cumin, chili powder, and smoked paprika.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken until browned on both sides.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté the diced onion, jalapeño, and garlic until softened and fragrant.
Whisk cornmeal, flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt with buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter, then fold in corn and cheddar.
Pour the cornbread batter evenly over the chicken and aromatics in the skillet, then bake at 400°F for about 40-45 minutes until the cornbread is golden and cooked through.
Stir softened butter with honey and minced chipotle in adobo until smooth to make the chipotle hot honey butter.
Slice the cornbread and chicken and serve with a generous spoonful of chipotle hot honey butter on top.
